entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • False positive IDE0010 on exhaustive pattern matching in switch statement #84657

Closed

  • Project loading reports cancellation error on shutdown #84619
  • Impossible to declare C# extension member from another .NET language #84629
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12027.142 #84653

PullRequests

Created

  • Add LSP daemon project-loading benchmarks #84667
    VSCode
  • Import selected roslyn-sdk components with preserved history #84665
    Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review
  • Unions: enforce the same order of processing for base interfaces of a member provider interface source vs. metadata. #84664
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Fix three defects in the VB grammar generator #84661
    Community
  • Cache more information for Closed Classes and Unions on NamedTypeSymbol #84660
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Closed Class Hierarchies, Feature - Unions
  • Escape token text in VB grammar generator #84659
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • More fixes for Razor multiline attribute formatting #84656
    Area-Razor
  • Implement type parameter inference from constraints #84655
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #84654

Merged

  • Restore EA project references in LanguageServer.csproj #84663
  • Ensure we don't log errors when we are cancelling loading #84622
    VSCode
  • Report LSP daemon lifecycle telemetry #84652
    VSCode
  • Unions: cache TryGetValue methods on NamedTypeSymbol representing a union type #84645
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions

  • Trim lsp dispatch allocations #84651
    VSCode
  • [release/stable] Snap insiders to stable #84648

  • [release/insiders] Snap main to insiders #84650

Updated

  • Fix IdeCore benchmark build isolation #84668

    Community, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Use vscode-uri semantics for parsing URIs #83593
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Stream project.assets.json when checking for unresolved package references #84647
    VSCode

  • Allow MSBuildWorkspace to open file-based apps #84139
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File

  • Encapsulate field: preserve field initializer #84480
